title: Convenient Protocol for Production and Purification of Clostridioides difficile Spores for Germination Studies
protocol: Place approximately 20 μL of frozen C. difficile spore stock on BHI+TCA plate in an anaerobic environment using a sterile inoculating loop.
Streak plates for single colony isolation.
Incubate plates anaerobically at 37°C for 1 to 2 days.
Mix 1:10 dilution of C. difficile spore stock in sterile ddH2O.
Heat the diluted spore stock in a water bath at 65°C for 20 minutes.
Vortex the heated spore stock solution thoroughly.
Pipette 20 μL of heated spore stock onto BHI+TCA plates under anaerobic conditions.
Streak each plate with a sterile inoculating loop to isolate single colonies.
Incubate the streaked plates anaerobically at 37°C for 1-2 days.
Flush a Spilfyter® bag with N2 several times and fill it with N2 before sealing.
Place all necessary materials inside the Spilfyter® bag before flushing with N2.
Incubate plates anaerobically in a BD GasPak™ EZ Anaerobic Container System using an anaerobic sachet.
Pre-reduce all plates for at least 2 h in an anaerobic environment.
Pick one vegetative colony from the BHI+TCA plate and transfer to a 70:30 sporulation plate using a sterile inoculating loop.
Streak the colony down the center of the 70:30 sporulation plate.
Spread the colony for confluent growth over the entirety of the 70:30 sporulation plate with a sterile inoculating loop.
Incubate plates anaerobically at 37°C for 4–5 days.
Scrape spores from the surface of a 70:30 sporulation plate using a sterile inoculating loop.
Incubate scraped material at 4°C to encourage spore release from mother cells.
Pipette 1.5 ml sterile ddH2O onto the surface of the sporulation plate containing confluent cell growth.
Scrape cell debris and spores free from the surface of the plate using a sterile inoculating loop.
Tilt the plate to collect suspended spore suspension and cell debris.
Transfer the solution with cell debris and spores into a sterile 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Vortex the tube to resuspend the contents.
Incubate sporulation plates at 4°C for 24 h up to 1 week to facilitate spore release from mother cells.
Pre-cool the swinging bucket rotor to 4°C in the centrifuge instrument.
Fill 15 mL conical tubes with 10 mL 50% (w/v) sucrose solution.
Remove 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes with spores and cell debris from 4°C storage.
Vortex to resuspend the contents of the tubes.
Pipette about 1.5 mL of spore prep onto the top of the 10 mL of 50% w/v sucrose solution in 15 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge 15 mL conical tubes at 3,600 rpm for 20 min to separate cell debris from spores.
Pipette upper cell debris layer on top of the sucrose solution and at the interface.
Remove remaining sucrose solution without disturbing the spore pellet using a pipettor.
Resuspend the spore pellet in 500 μL sterile room temperature ddH2O in 15 mL conical tubes.
Combine resuspended spore pellets from two 15 mL conical tubes into one 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and vortex.
Centrifuge 1.5 mL tubes at 14,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove supernatant with pipette.
Resuspend the spore pellet in 1 mL sterile ddH2O and vortex.
If spore pellet is difficult to resuspend, pipette up and down to encourage resuspension.
Centrifuge the mixture at 14,000 × g for 5 min.
Wash the pellet as described above for a total of 5 washes.
Resuspend spore pellet to a final volume of 1 mL with sterile ddH2O after the final wash.
Store purified spore preparation at 4°C in a glass vial.
Make a 1:10 dilution of spores in sterile ddH2O for enumeration.
Vortex the mixture to distribute spores.
Place 5 μL of dilution on a Petroff-Hauser counting chamber with a depth of 0.02 mm.
Place a drop of immersion oil on top of the cover slip.
Count spores, vegetative cells, and spores in mother cells using phase contrast microscopy at 100× magnification lens.
Identify spores as small, phase-bright rods.
Identify vegetative cells as long, phase-dark rods.
Identify spores in mother cells as rods with a bright oval at the end.
Calculate the number of spores per mL based on the counts.
Determine the purity of the spore preparation.
Pre-reduce BHI+TCA plates in an anaerobic environment for at least 2 hr prior to use.
Flush a Spilfyter® bag with N2 several times, fill it with N2 and seal.
Place all necessary materials inside the Spilfyter® bag before flushing with N2.
Make serial dilutions of spore stock in sterile ddH2O in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes (10−1, 10−2, 10−3, etc.).
Heat centrifuge tubes containing spore dilutions in a water bath at 65°C for 20 min.
Plate 100 μL of spore dilution on reduced BHI + TCA plates and spread evenly over the plate with a sterile inoculating loop.
Incubate anaerobically at 37°C for 1–2 days.
Count the number of colonies on plates that have between 30 and 300 colonies to determine CFUs.
